pages.text: $(thing)Effect Pages$() are curses and blessings kept apart from ordinary symbols. To bind one, include the rare $(thing)Age Effect$() marker and one non-instant status-effect page. Their relative order does not matter; if several effects are present, the last is chosen and the disagreement adds instability.

An Age Effect is not the same as instability. Once each second, every survival traveler has a 6% chance to receive the chosen effect for 9 seconds, without particles or an icon. Creative and spectator travelers are exempt. Writing one adds 65 instability before other adjustments.
A steward may speak $(thing)/mystcraft age_effect toggle$() within the Age to silence or restore the bound effect. If no such mark was written, the Age has nothing to answer.
